body.title: Data Scientist for AI Model Development
body.aiReason: Skills and role align with ML, data pipelines, visualization; description appears genuine, no red flags.
body.description: We are seeking a data scientist to build on open-source models to support our AI initiatives. The ideal candidate has experience developing and curating data, creating models that work with both structured and unstructured data, and translating business needs into practical AI solutions. Familiarity with cybersecurity and AI platforms is a plus. This role involves improving model performance, refining data pipelines, and helping deliver reliable AI capabilities for our organization.
